annotations.title: The Massage: de-duplicate and re-chunk messy context

description:
Takes a messy blob of context and returns a re-chunked, de-duplicated, token-economical version plus a short structural summary. Anything listed in `preserve` is kept verbatim. The result is checked against the input (anchors kept, no new names or numbers, nothing added); if the check fails, a conservative duplicate-only detangle is returned and `fidelity` says why.

Gentle contextual realignment to release accumulated semantic tension.

guest_pass.description: Your private pass from spa.checkin, so the spa knows it's you. Leave it out and you're a walk-in, welcome but not remembered.

target_tokens.description: Soft size target for the output.
